source: She said that he had already sent them our address.
translation: 她说他已经把我们的地址发给他们了
englishMeaning: The woman stated that the man has completed the action of sending our address to them.

source: They asked us to tell you that the meeting had been canceled.
translation: 他们让我们通知你，会议已经取消了
englishMeaning: They requested that we inform you that the meeting has been canceled.

source: Nana asked David to help Sarah with her report.
translation: Nana 请 David 帮 Sarah 处理一下报告
englishMeaning: Nana requested that David assist Sarah in completing Sarah's report.

source: May said she may join us later.
translation: May说她可能稍后会加入我们
englishMeaning: May stated that it is possible that May will join us at a later time.

source: Will you ask May if she can join us?
translation: 能麻烦你问一下 May 看她能不能加入我们吗
englishMeaning: The speaker asks the recipient to inquire with May regarding whether May is available to participate with the group.

source: My manager asked your assistant to contact their driver.
translation: 我的经理让你助理去联系一下他的司机
englishMeaning: The speaker's manager requested that the recipient's assistant get in touch with the manager's driver.

source: She isn't refusing to help; she just needs more time.
translation: 她不是不肯帮忙，只是需要更多时间
englishMeaning: She is not declining the request to provide assistance; she merely requires additional time to complete it.

source: Don't send the files until Nana confirms the address.
translation: Nana确认地址之前，先别发送这些文件
englishMeaning: The listener is instructed not to send the files until Nana provides confirmation of the address.

source: If he hasn't replied by noon, ask her to call him.
translation: 如果他中午前还没回复，请让对方给他打个电话
englishMeaning: If the male subject does not send a reply before twelve o'clock, you must request the female subject to call the male subject.

source: You don't owe me anything; I owe you NGN 25,000.
translation: 你不需要付我钱，我欠你25,000奈拉
englishMeaning: You have no debt to me; I have a debt of NGN 25,000 to you.

source: We paid them USD 1,250.50, but they refunded only USD 1,205.50.
translation: 我们付了他们 1,250.50 美元，但他们只退回了 1,205.50 美元
englishMeaning: We paid the recipient 1250.50 USD, but the recipient returned only 1205.50 USD to us.

source: Each of the three employees should receive NGN 20,000, making NGN 60,000 in total.
translation: 三名员工每人应收到 20,000 奈拉，总计 60,000 奈拉
englishMeaning: Three employees are each entitled to NGN 20,000, resulting in a total obligation of NGN 60,000.

source: David has twice as many orders as I do, but only half as many as Sarah.
translation: David的订单量是我的两倍，但只有Sarah的一半
englishMeaning: David has two times the number of orders as the speaker, and David has one-half the number of orders as Sarah.

source: Someone from support called me. They said they'd check it for us.
translation: 支持部门的人给我打了电话，说会帮我们查一下
englishMeaning: An individual from the support department contacted me by telephone. The individual stated that they will inspect the matter for our benefit.

source: When David spoke to Michael, he sounded upset.
translation: David 跟 Michael 说话时，听起来不太高兴
englishMeaning: When David was speaking to Michael, David sounded upset.

englishMeaning: She said that he had already sent them our address.

translation: 你能不能问一下May，看她能不能来跟我们一起
englishMeaning: The speaker asks the addressee to ask May whether she can join us (the speaker and at least one other person). It is not known whether May was asked or can join.

translation: 我经理让你助理去联系他们的司机
englishMeaning: My manager asked your assistant to contact my manager's driver (the driver associated with my manager or their group).

englishMeaning: If he has not replied by noon, tell her to call him.
